subject_definitions.identity: 白色短发遮眼刘海与小翘发；半透明浅紫鼠耳异变结构；小体型；宽大浅色短袍；深色领口、袖口与下摆边块；斜挎带与侧包；谨慎克制的神态。
subject_definitions.instance_rule: 全片仅一个鼠耳异变少女实体；禁止复制、分身、镜像完整人物、第二人物或可见第二生物。
subject_definitions.action_limit: 半身动态视图只支持耳、眼、头、肩等低幅动作；全身身份图仅支持一次小幅侧移，不做奔跑、跳跃或大幅转身。

changed_variable.name: safe_boundary_relation
changed_variable.before: 角色停在既有较安静的明暗边界旁，以静止和单耳警觉保持距离。
changed_variable.after: 明暗边界轻移后，角色完成一次小幅侧移，主动选择相邻较稳定的位置并停稳。

dynamic_chain.start: N8 + NZ7：静止、谨慎，依赖既有安静边界保持安全感。
dynamic_chain.change: XZ6克N5：既有环境光带轻移，压缩原先的安静区域；耳先于眼和头读取变化。
dynamic_chain.result: NZ补N至7并生Z至7：她以一次小幅侧移重新建立与环境的距离，服装和侧包落稳，回看一次后停止。

另一只耳对齐，头和肩小幅同向，身体仍未移动。
一次小幅侧移完成，袍摆、斜挎带和侧包自然落稳，角色停住并短暂回看。

action_plan: 0–4秒：唯一角色静止，呼吸轻微，双耳保持不对称警觉。

segments.ambient_soundscape: 村庄远处的低风、轻微木石环境摩擦与稀薄空气底噪；明暗变化点加入一次很轻的风压变化。仅作音效设计。
segments.emotional_sound_cue: 无歌词、无强拍的低音悬停；近侧耳转动时出现一次短而克制的柔和泛音，随后收住。仅辅助警觉转折，不做MV。
segments.audio_role: support environmental event and readable emotional shift; no beat-synced cutting and no MV logic
segments.prompt: 2D hand-drawn cinematic character sequence, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16. STYLE IDENTITY LOCK: preserve the exact line quality, materials, original colors and design language visible in Picture 1 for the only character, and preserve the verified five-color palette logic and environmental material language of Picture 2. Do not impose colors or glowing materials that conflict with either source. VISUAL EXPRESSION: clear readable shapes, restrained variable-weight linework, light wash-like shading, soft diffuse illumination and generous negative space only where compatible with the references. CHARACTER — Picture 1: one and only one mouse-ear mutant girl, preserving her short white hair with eye-covering fringe and small curl, translucent pale-violet mouse-ear structures, small slender proportions, oversized pale robe, dark collar, cuffs and hem blocks, diagonal strap and side satchel. The multiple views describe the same single identity, never multiple people. ENVIRONMENT — Picture 2: retain the identity, existing elements, spatial continuity and five-color palette logic of the heterogeneous village. Picture 2 does not lock the framing. Do not invent a new building, door, machine, prop or unseen reverse view. CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: a slightly elevated three-quarter medium-wide shot, the sole character placed on one side with ample open space in the direction she watches; use only foreground forms supported by Picture 2, keep its village layers in the background, and hold the camera still. ACTION: at first she stands quietly with subtle breathing and asymmetrical alert ears. An existing boundary between darker and brighter areas of the environment slowly shifts across the ground without creating a new light source. Her nearer ear turns first, then her eyes follow, then her head turns only a little. Her shoulder tightens and the other ear begins to align; her feet and body remain still, and she stops in a cautious listening pose. Keep the action continuous and readable, not rhythmic editing. Only one physical character instance appears. NEGATIVE: no second person, no visible creature, no duplicate or clone, no complete humanlike reflection or shadow double, no split screen, no character-sheet layout, no four-person interpretation of reference views, no identity redesign, no cyan-white energy humanoid, no new wings, weapons, clothes or anatomy, no location replacement, no unsupported object, no glossy 3D, no hard digital edges, no text, subtitle, logo or watermark.

12–15秒：袍摆、斜挎带和侧包落稳；角色短暂回看原位置一次，随后停住。

segments.prompt: 2D hand-drawn cinematic character sequence, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, continuing directly from the selected final frame of Segment A. STYLE IDENTITY LOCK: preserve the exact line quality, materials, original colors and design language visible in Picture 1 for the only character, and preserve the verified five-color palette logic and environmental material language of Picture 2. Do not impose colors or glowing materials that conflict with either source. VISUAL EXPRESSION: clear readable shapes, restrained variable-weight linework, light wash-like shading, soft diffuse illumination and controlled negative space only where compatible with the references. CHARACTER — Picture 1: the same one and only mouse-ear mutant girl from Segment A, preserving her short white hair with eye-covering fringe and small curl, translucent pale-violet mouse-ear structures, small slender proportions, oversized pale robe, dark collar, cuffs and hem blocks, diagonal strap and side satchel. The multiple views describe one identity, never several people. Her upper body leans slightly in that direction, then she takes one small lateral step, no running and no turn. Her robe hem, diagonal strap and side satchel settle naturally. She looks back once toward her former position and comes to a complete stop. Keep one continuous restrained action, not rhythmic editing. Only one physical character instance appears.
